fixed_by_run.why: 1) Stale preview: Must Read 3 'RBI meets bank chiefs today on new loan-loss rules as SBI puts the hit at Rs 19,500 crore' previews a meeting due earlier today. The page time is about 6:30 pm. Rewrite it to report where things stand (no outcome announced by evening) or drop it. In This Week, 'Today: Retail inflation (CPI) for October, 4 pm' is also past. Replace it with the released October figure or remove it. 2) Hours-old figure: Must Read 2 'Delhi's air slips back to 319 on Thursday morning, with IIT Delhi at a severe 413' gives a morning AQI in the evening. Update it to the latest reading. 3) Two business stories in the top headlines: Must Read 1 (CII Partnership Summit, 141 MoUs, Rs 12.14 lakh crore) and Must Read 3 (RBI loan-loss rules, SBI Rs 19,500 crore), next to a fiscal Cabinet lead. Keep at most one. 4) The lead is the Wednesday, November 11 Cabinet decision, now more than 24 hours old, and its headline pairs the fertiliser subsidy with an unrelated museum. Fresher November 12 news sits lower: two Special Police Officers found shot dead in Kishtwar with their service rifles gone, and Ujjal Biswas's death. Lead with the biggest current story, such as Kishtwar, and move the Cabinet story down under a single-subject headline. 5) Mobile: the sticky bottom navigation bar covers the first lead-block headline ('Former Bengal minister Ujjal Biswas dies at 72...'), so only half a line shows. Make sure no lead-block text sits behind the bar.
